title: Infra Hygiene: Raster Project Json, Remodel Launch Entries, Note Plugin Lockfile Cleanup
description: Three independent infra hygiene fixes: 1) Add missing raster/rs/project.json modeled on sibling Rust/WASM crates. 2) Add missing "remodel" trio (⚛️react, 🧊wgpu🌐wasm, 🧊wgpu🖥️native) entries to .vscode/launch.json under 3_dev group. 3) Remove wrongly-committed note/plugin/rs/Cargo.lock and target/ (the only plugin crate with these checked in), and check whether root .gitignore covers this pattern. (Intended parent: 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES, but ticket_open rejected it with "ticket not found" despite the folder existing on disk and being tracked in git — opened as a standalone ticket instead.)
summary:
Re-verification + completion pass on this 3-item infra hygiene ticket (previously closed by an earlier session at 15:29; this pass re-verified all 3 items fresh and fixed a drift found in item 1).

1) raster/rs/project.json: existed already (from the prior close) with only a "wasm" target. Found it had drifted out of sync with its template sibling draw/rs, which now has both "wasm" and "test" nx targets — and raster/rs/lib.rs has real #[cfg(test)] mod tests / mod raster_vcs_tests blocks that were unreachable via nx. Added a "test" target to project.json (mirrors draw/rs's project.json exactly: nx:run-commands -> "bun ./script.ts test") and added a TestScript class to raster/rs/script.ts registered as "test" (mirrors draw/rs/script.ts exactly: execFileSync("cargo", ["test", "-p", "raster", ...segments], { stdio: "inherit", cwd: this.root })). Verified structurally with `bun nx show project @semio-tech/raster-rs` (both "wasm" and "test" targets present) and end-to-end with `bun nx run @semio-tech/raster-rs:test` — compiled clean and ran 12 tests, all passing (test result: ok. 12 passed; 0 failed).

2) .vscode/launch.json remodel trio: already present and correct from the prior close (🛠️dev🏺remodel⚛️react / 🧊wgpu🌐wasm / 🧊wgpu🖥️native at group "3_dev", orders 389/389.1/389.2, ports 6063/6163 verified still unique repo-wide, "dev:remodel" script confirmed present in root package.json). No changes needed; re-verified only.

3) note/plugin/rs Cargo.lock/target/: already absent from both the filesystem (`ls note/plugin/rs/` shows only Cargo.toml and lib.rs) and from git (`git ls-tree -r HEAD -- note/plugin/rs/` shows only Cargo.toml and lib.rs; `git status --porcelain -- note/plugin/rs` is clean). The prior close's claim that Cargo.lock was still git-tracked no longer holds — either it was corrected between sessions or that finding was inaccurate; either way nothing is currently tracked, so no human git action is needed at this time. Re-checked .gitignore: no per-crate "Cargo.lock" pattern exists (only "target/", "target*", "project.lock.json" etc.), so if a Cargo.lock is ever re-added under a plugin crate in the future it would NOT be auto-ignored — this residual gitignore gap is still worth a human decision but is not urgent since nothing is currently tracked.

Files touched this pass: raster/rs/project.json (added "test" target), raster/rs/script.ts (added TestScript class + "test" registration + updated docstring/import). No other files modified.
